title: Show-Cause / Contempt Hearing (Support, Parenting Time, or Custody Order Enforcement)
what_it_is: A hearing where a party must explain why they should not be held in contempt for failing to comply with an order or judgment. The Friend of the Court may move for an order to show cause, or schedule a hearing directly in nonpayment-of-support cases (MCR 3.208(B)).
who_is_in_the_room: The Friend of the Court, unless the court holds the hearing without it (MCR 3.208(B)(5)).
sequence: An order or notice of the show-cause hearing is served personally, by ordinary mail, or as MCR 3.203 permits (MCR 3.208(B)(2)).
The hearing may be held no sooner than 7 days after personal service, or 9 days after service by ordinary mail (MCR 3.208(B)(4)).
The court may hold the hearing without the Friend of the Court unless further FOC-record information is needed (MCR 3.208(B)(5)).
If the responding party fails to appear, the court may issue an order for arrest (MCR 3.208(B)(5)).
prepare: The specific order term you are alleged to have violated, or that you allege was violated - read it exactly, not from memory.
A pattern log with dates, not a single incident, if you are the one alleging noncompliance.
Documentation of any compliance already made (payments, makeup parenting time offered) if you are responding.
A calm, factual explanation for any missed compliance - context, not excuse.

applicable_rules.summary: The Friend of the Court may move for an order to show cause why a party should not be held in contempt for failing to comply with an order or judgment; the notice must be served as MCR 3.203 provides.
The hearing may be held no sooner than 7 days after service, or 9 days if served by ordinary mail.
Failure to appear at the show-cause hearing may result in an order for arrest.

deadlines.label: Minimum notice before a show-cause hearing

traps.trap: Treating a show-cause hearing as a chance to relitigate the whole case.
traps.safe_move: Answer only the specific violation alleged, with dates and the order's exact terms.
Failure to appear can result in an order for arrest (MCR 3.208(B)(5)). If you cannot attend, seek an adjournment in writing before the date.

traps.trap: Explaining noncompliance with a characterization of the other parent instead of facts.
traps.safe_move: State what happened and when; do not diagnose or label anyone (GUARDRAILS.md S2).

traps.trap: Assuming a vague order term is enforceable.
traps.safe_move: The FOC may decline to enforce a term that is not specific (MCL 552.641(2)(c)) - PROVISIONAL, confirm current text.

do_not: Never characterize the other parent with a clinical label as a pleaded claim (narcissist, alienator, PAS, coercive control) - GUARDRAILS.md S2.
Never use the child as a witness, messenger, interviewee, or source, and never record the child - GUARDRAILS.md S8, absolute.
Never assert that any recording you made is lawful - Michigan law is unsettled and the exposure is criminal.
Never sign or stipulate to anything on the spot without reading it fully first.

openers: Good morning/afternoon, Your Honor. My name is [Party], and I am representing myself.
I am here to address [narrow issue]. I have [N] exhibits and a short chronology.
closers: I don't have that information, but I can provide records if needed.
I'd like the record to reflect [narrow, factual point] and I reserve my right to address anything broader in the appropriate forum.

safety_gates: immediate danger -> 911, do not proceed on this guide alone
PPO/DV/CPS contact live -> stop, safety resources, do not proceed on this guide alone
UCCJEA/interstate fact -> stop, MC 416 affidavit guidance
recording question in any form -> unsettled law, criminal exposure, attorney question only
child asked/expected to speak to anyone about the case -> stop
exit_checklist: Write down the date, who appeared, and what was decided or taken under advisement before leaving the building.
Write on any document handed to you the date you received it - that date can start a clock.
Calendar every deadline this event started, counted from the earliest possible trigger date.
Note whether anything was requested that you did not have time to answer fully, and follow up in writing.
